notablePrerequisites:
You have a static effect granting your creatures haste.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
description:
Declare Brago and Port Razer as attackers.
When they deal combat damage, Brago and Port Razer trigger.
Resolve Port Razer's trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get another combat phase after this one.
Resolve Brago's trigger, blinking Port Razer and any number of other nonland permanents you control.
Repeat.
